mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(A.EPISODE, '%y년 %m월 %d일') AS episode, B.USER_ID AS userId, A.LOCATION AS location FROM MEETING_SCHEDULE A LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) B ON A.EPISODE = B.EPISODE WHERE A.COMPLETE_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY A.EPISODE ASC

SELECT episode from MEETING_SCHEDULE WHERE EPISODE = DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{episode}, '%y년 %m월 %d일'), '%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00') AND HEADCOUNT > ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PARTICIPANT_USER A WHERE A.EPISODE = DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{episode}, '%y년 %m월 %d일'), '%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00') )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PARTICIPANT_USER(USER_ID, EPISODE) VALUES(#{userId}, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{episode}, '%y년 %m월 %d일'), '%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00'))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND EPISODE = DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{episode}, '%y년 %m월 %d일'), '%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00')
mapper.select: SELECT pass_flag FROM user_manage WHERE user_id = #{userId}
